identity.name: CI trust boundaries
identity.description: Highlight dangerous GitHub Actions trust and privilege transitions.

rules.label: Privileged pull request workflow trigger changed
rules.check: Verify that fork-provided input cannot execute with repository secrets or write tokens.

rules.label: Broad workflow write permissions changed
rules.check: Confirm minimum required permissions and the identity/token scope of the job.

rules.label: Workflow dynamic script or shell usage changed
rules.check: Inspect shell interpolation, untrusted context and checkout credential persistence.

protectedPaths.reason: Workflow privilege changes require passing workflow security checks.

requiredChecks.reason: Check patch hygiene and run applicable CI workflow/security tests without executing changed project code automatically.
